prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity portrait mobile web app composition, 393x852 viewport
Primary request: LifeGoods Khmer-first packaged-food barcode home screen, camera-first composition, visual option A
Input images: the two user screenshots are structural references only; borrow their direct scan-first hierarchy and high legibility, never their brands, scores, verdicts, colors, or content
Structure: sticky white header with a small dark-green Phosphor-style palm tree icon and LifeGoods wordmark left, one compact language switch button ‘English’ right; a large neutral deep-charcoal camera-placeholder viewfinder occupies about 38% of the first viewport with four crisp scan corners, a camera icon, and visible Khmer-first ‘Camera scanning coming soon’ status; immediately below, a white barcode-entry dock with visible Khmer label, numeric field, barcode icon, and dark-green ‘Check barcode’ action; fixed four-item bottom navigation Home, Learn, History, Allergies with simple consistent line icons and text labels
Style/medium: polished production mobile UI mockup, calm evidence-first shopping utility, flat layered surfaces, strong typography, generous Khmer line-height, restrained 12–16px radii, no decorative shadows
Color palette: white, neutral gray, charcoal ink, restrained forest green under 10% of screen
Text (verbatim where possible): ‘LifeGoods’, ‘English’, ‘ពិនិត្យបាកូដលើកញ្ចប់’, ‘ការស្កេនកាមេរ៉ានឹងមកដល់ឆាប់ៗ’, ‘លេខបាកូដ’, ‘ពិនិត្យបាកូដ’, ‘Home’, ‘Learn’, ‘History’, ‘Allergies’
Constraints: camera region must look explicitly unavailable rather than live; barcode entry is the only functioning-looking primary action; icons have text labels; mobile safe areas; no product claims
Avoid: Open Food Facts logo, product score, green checks, health labels, gradients, glassmorphism, wellness marketing, nested cards, photos, fake camera imagery, dark theme, watermark
